message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crime(s) based on facts. The facts: person performed medical diagnosis/treatment without a medical license. Also possessed medical supplies (injection liquids, etc.). This is illegal medical practice. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法行医" (illegal practice of medicine). Possibly also "非法行医罪" (illegal medical practice). Could also be "非法行医罪" and maybe "非法买卖药品" but they just possessed medicines for use. The typical charge: "非法行医" (practicing medicine without a license). In examples, they used "非法行医;非法进行节育手术" for a case with abortion. Here only illegal practice. So answer: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法买卖、运输、储存危险物品"? No. The items are medical supplies, not illegal. So single crime.
